parameters.query:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS career_ops;
COMMENT ON SCHEMA career_ops IS 'Projection interrogeable des candidatures. Source de verite = data-inbox/*.json (repo Biribin/cv) + tracker career-ops local. Supprimable et reconstructible : node db/reproject.mjs | psql';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_ops.parametre (
  cle         text PRIMARY KEY,
  valeur      text NOT NULL,
  provenance  text NOT NULL,
  maj_le      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO career_ops.parametre (cle, valeur, provenance) VALUES
  ('relance_delai_jours', '7', 'career-ops/followup-cadence.mjs DEFAULT_CADENCE.applied_first'),
  ('relance_max',         '2', 'career-ops/followup-cadence.mjs DEFAULT_CADENCE.applied_max_followups')
ON CONFLICT (cle) DO UPDATE SET provenance = EXCLUDED.provenance, maj_le = now();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION career_ops.parametre_entier(p_cle text, p_defaut int)
RETURNS int LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT valeur::int FROM career_ops.parametre WHERE cle = p_cle), p_defaut)
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_ops.statut (
  code              text PRIMARY KEY,
  label_career_ops  text NOT NULL,
  terminal          boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  description       text NOT NULL
);
INSERT INTO career_ops.statut (code, label_career_ops, terminal, description) VALUES
  ('A_VALIDER',        'Evaluated', false, 'Fiche ecrite, porte de validation ouverte, rien n''est parti'),
  ('RETOUCHE',         'Evaluated', false, 'Retouche CV ou lettre demandee, nouveau round en cours'),
  ('VALIDEE',          'Evaluated', false, 'Decision « valider » prise, envoi en cours'),
  ('ENVOYEE',          'Applied',   true,  'Courriel de candidature parti chez le recruteur'),
  ('PORTAIL_A_COLLER', 'Evaluated', false, 'Pas de courriel recruteur : depot manuel sur le portail encore a faire'),
  ('REFUSEE',          'Discarded', true,  'Lineo a refuse l''offre (la raison alimente analyze-patterns.mjs)'),
  ('ERREUR',           'Evaluated', false, 'Decision invalide, timeout de la porte, ou echec technique amont')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET label_career_ops = EXCLUDED.label_career_ops, terminal = EXCLUDED.terminal, description = EXCLUDED.description;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_ops.offre (
  id                text PRIMARY KEY,
  source            text NOT NULL,
  poste             text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  entreprise        text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  lieu              text,
  teletravail       text,
  url               text,
  courriel_contact  text,
  score             smallint CHECK (score IS NULL OR score BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
  publiee_le        date,
  pourquoi_ca_matche text,
  fiche_path        text NOT NULL,
  fiche_schema      text,
  projete_le        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.offre.id IS 'slug(jobId) — identique au nom de fichier data-inbox/<id>.json';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.offre.score IS 'job.relevanceScore (0-100) du parser « Parse: Search Results ». NULL quand l''agent ne l''a pas rempli.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.offre.publiee_le IS 'Date de publication de l''offre. Reste NULL tant que « Parse: Search Results » ne retient pas le champ date de France Travail.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.offre.courriel_contact IS 'contact.courriel France Travail. Vide = l''envoi retombe sur l''adresse de Lineo (filet de securite, session S4).';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.offre.teletravail IS 'job.location.remotePolicy : On-site | Remote | Hybrid | Not Specified';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offre_entreprise_idx ON career_ops.offre (lower(entreprise));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offre_score_idx ON career_ops.offre (score DESC NULLS LAST);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_ops.candidature (
  id              bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  offre_id        text NOT NULL REFERENCES career_ops.offre(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  statut          text NOT NULL REFERENCES career_ops.statut(code),
  branche_github  text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  tag_archive     text,
  envoyee_le      timestamptz,
  message_id      text,
  execution_id    text,
  revision        integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  inbox_path      text,
  cree_le         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  projete_le      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.candidature.branche_github IS 'cv/<entreprise>-<poste>-<suffixe execution> — cle naturelle de la candidature';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.candidature.tag_archive IS 'sent/<entreprise>-<AAAA-MM-JJ> : tag annote qui conserve le CV et la lettre exacts envoyes (session S2). git show <tag>:dist/pdf/cv-fr-ats.pdf';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.candidature.envoyee_le IS 'Horodatage de l''envoi REEL au recruteur. NULL sur le chemin portail : rien n''est parti.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.candidature.message_id IS 'id du message Gmail — seul lien entre une candidature et le courriel effectivement envoye';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.candidature.revision IS 'Revision de la fiche inbox au dernier passage : 0 = premier jet, n = apres n retouches';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidature_offre_idx ON career_ops.candidature (offre_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidature_statut_idx ON career_ops.candidature (statut);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS candidature_envoi_idx ON career_ops.candidature (envoyee_le) WHERE envoyee_le IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_ops.decision (
  id              bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  candidature_id  bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES career_ops.candidature(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type            text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('valider', 'retoucher_lettre', 'retoucher_cv', 'refuser', 'decision_invalide')),
  consigne        text,
  raison          text,
  decidee_le      timestamptz NOT NULL,
  revision        integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  projete_le      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (candidature_id, revision)
);
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.decision.type IS 'Les 4 issues de la porte de validation + decision_invalide pour le fallback (POST malforme, timeout 7 j). Aucun envoi possible sur decision_invalide.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.decision.consigne IS 'Consigne libre de Lineo sur une retouche. Alimente le prompt de l''agent au round suivant.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.decision.raison IS 'Raison d''un refus. Non contrainte volontairement : mieux vaut un refus sans raison enregistre qu''un INSERT rejete. Les manques sortent dans v_qualite_projection.';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS decision_type_idx ON career_ops.decision (type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS decision_refus_idx ON career_ops.decision (decidee_le DESC) WHERE type = 'refuser';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS career_ops.relance (
  id              bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  candidature_id  bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES career_ops.candidature(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  echeance        date NOT NULL,
  envoyee_le      timestamptz,
  rang            smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (rang >= 1),
  projete_le      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (candidature_id, echeance)
);
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.relance.echeance IS 'Date a laquelle la relance devient due. Amorcee par n8n a envoi + relance_delai_jours ; les suivantes restent du ressort de career-ops/followup-cadence.mjs.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN career_ops.relance.envoyee_le IS 'NULL = relance encore en attente. C''est ce qui fait apparaitre la ligne dans v_relance_due.';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS relance_due_idx ON career_ops.relance (echeance) WHERE envoyee_le IS NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW career_ops.v_candidature AS
SELECT c.id, o.entreprise, o.poste, o.lieu, o.teletravail, o.score, c.statut, s.label_career_ops,
       o.courriel_contact, c.envoyee_le, c.tag_archive, c.branche_github, c.revision,
       d.type AS derniere_decision, d.raison AS derniere_raison, d.consigne AS derniere_consigne,
       d.decidee_le AS derniere_decision_le, o.url, o.id AS offre_id, c.inbox_path
FROM career_ops.candidature c
JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
JOIN career_ops.statut s ON s.code = c.statut
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT type, raison, consigne, decidee_le FROM career_ops.decision d
  WHERE d.candidature_id = c.id ORDER BY d.revision DESC, d.decidee_le DESC LIMIT 1
) d ON true;
COMMENT ON VIEW career_ops.v_candidature IS 'Vue de lecture principale : une ligne par candidature, avec sa derniere decision et le label career-ops correspondant.';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW career_ops.v_relance_due AS
SELECT c.id AS candidature_id, o.entreprise, o.poste, o.courriel_contact,
       c.envoyee_le::date AS envoyee_le,
       (current_date - c.envoyee_le::date) AS jours_depuis_envoi,
       COALESCE(r.echeance, (c.envoyee_le + make_interval(days => career_ops.parametre_entier('relance_delai_jours', 7)))::date) AS echeance,
       current_date - COALESCE(r.echeance, (c.envoyee_le + make_interval(days => career_ops.parametre_entier('relance_delai_jours', 7)))::date) AS jours_de_retard,
       COALESCE(r.rang, 1) AS rang,
       (r.id IS NULL) AS echeance_recalculee,
       c.tag_archive, c.branche_github, o.url
FROM career_ops.candidature c
JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT id, echeance, rang FROM career_ops.relance r
  WHERE r.candidature_id = c.id AND r.envoyee_le IS NULL ORDER BY r.echeance LIMIT 1
) r ON true
WHERE c.statut = 'ENVOYEE'
  AND c.envoyee_le IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM career_ops.decision d WHERE d.candidature_id = c.id AND d.type = 'refuser')
  AND COALESCE(r.echeance, (c.envoyee_le + make_interval(days => career_ops.parametre_entier('relance_delai_jours', 7)))::date) <= current_date;
COMMENT ON VIEW career_ops.v_relance_due IS 'Candidatures envoyees dont la relance est due et pas encore envoyee. echeance_recalculee = true quand aucune ligne relance n''avait ete amorcee.';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW career_ops.v_motif_refus AS
SELECT d.raison, count(*) AS occurrences, min(d.decidee_le)::date AS premier_refus,
       max(d.decidee_le)::date AS dernier_refus, round(avg(o.score)::numeric, 1) AS score_moyen,
       array_agg(DISTINCT o.entreprise ORDER BY o.entreprise) AS entreprises
FROM career_ops.decision d
JOIN career_ops.candidature c ON c.id = d.candidature_id
JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
WHERE d.type = 'refuser' AND NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(d.raison, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.raison ORDER BY occurrences DESC, dernier_refus DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW career_ops.v_qualite_projection AS
SELECT 'refus sans raison' AS anomalie, c.id AS candidature_id, o.entreprise, o.poste,
       'analyze-patterns.mjs ne pourra rien en tirer' AS consequence
FROM career_ops.decision d
JOIN career_ops.candidature c ON c.id = d.candidature_id
JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
WHERE d.type = 'refuser' AND NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(d.raison, '')), '') IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'envoyee sans message_id', c.id, o.entreprise, o.poste,
       'aucun lien entre la candidature et le courriel envoye'
FROM career_ops.candidature c JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
WHERE c.statut = 'ENVOYEE' AND NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(c.message_id, '')), '') IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'envoyee sans tag archive', c.id, o.entreprise, o.poste,
       'le CV et la lettre exacts envoyes ne sont plus recuperables'
FROM career_ops.candidature c JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
WHERE c.statut = 'ENVOYEE' AND NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(c.tag_archive, '')), '') IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'bloquee dans la porte', c.id, o.entreprise, o.poste,
       'fiche ecrite mais aucune decision depuis plus de 7 jours'
FROM career_ops.candidature c JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id
WHERE c.statut IN ('A_VALIDER', 'RETOUCHE', 'VALIDEE')
  AND c.cree_le < now() - make_interval(days => career_ops.parametre_entier('relance_delai_jours', 7))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM career_ops.decision d WHERE d.candidature_id = c.id);

WITH f AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d),
o AS (
  INSERT INTO career_ops.offre AS cible (
    id, source, poste, entreprise, lieu, teletravail, url, courriel_contact,
    score, publiee_le, pourquoi_ca_matche, fiche_path, fiche_schema)
  SELECT
    d->>'id',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'source', ''), 'inconnue'),
    COALESCE(d->>'poste', ''),
    COALESCE(d->>'entreprise', ''),
    NULLIF(COALESCE(d->'lieu'->>'city', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d->'lieu') = 'string' THEN d->>'lieu' END, ''), ''),
    NULLIF(COALESCE(d->'lieu'->>'remotePolicy', ''), ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'url_offre', ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'courriel_contact', '')), ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'score', '')::smallint,
    NULLIF(d->>'publiee_le', '')::date,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'pourquoi_ca_matche', '')), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'fiche_path', ''), 'data-inbox/' || (d->>'id') || '.json'),
    d->>'schema'
  FROM f
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    source = EXCLUDED.source, poste = EXCLUDED.poste, entreprise = EXCLUDED.entreprise,
    lieu = EXCLUDED.lieu, teletravail = EXCLUDED.teletravail, url = EXCLUDED.url,
    courriel_contact = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.courriel_contact, cible.courriel_contact),
    score = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.score, cible.score),
    publiee_le = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.publiee_le, cible.publiee_le),
    pourquoi_ca_matche = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pourquoi_ca_matche, cible.pourquoi_ca_matche),
    fiche_path = EXCLUDED.fiche_path, fiche_schema = EXCLUDED.fiche_schema, projete_le = now()
  RETURNING cible.id
),
c AS (
  INSERT INTO career_ops.candidature AS cand (
    offre_id, statut, branche_github, execution_id, revision, inbox_path, cree_le)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM o), 'A_VALIDER', d->>'branche_github', NULLIF(d->>'execution_id', ''),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'revision', '')::int, 0),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'fiche_path', ''), 'data-inbox/' || (d->>'id') || '.json'),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'cree_le', '')::timestamptz, now())
  FROM f
  WHERE NULLIF(d->>'branche_github', '') IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (branche_github) DO UPDATE SET
    statut = CASE WHEN cand.statut IN ('ENVOYEE', 'REFUSEE') THEN cand.statut ELSE 'A_VALIDER' END,
    revision = GREATEST(cand.revision, EXCLUDED.revision),
    inbox_path = EXCLUDED.inbox_path, projete_le = now()
  RETURNING cand.id, cand.statut, cand.revision
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM o) AS offre_id, (SELECT id FROM c) AS candidature_id,
       (SELECT statut FROM c) AS statut, (SELECT revision FROM c) AS revision,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS candidature_ecrite

WITH e AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d),
cible AS (
  SELECT cand.id FROM career_ops.candidature cand, e WHERE cand.branche_github = e.d->>'branche_github'
),
maj AS (
  UPDATE career_ops.candidature cand
     SET statut = CASE (SELECT d->>'decision' FROM e)
                    WHEN 'valider' THEN 'VALIDEE'
                    WHEN 'refuser' THEN 'REFUSEE'
                    WHEN 'retoucher_lettre' THEN 'RETOUCHE'
                    WHEN 'retoucher_cv' THEN 'RETOUCHE'
                    ELSE 'ERREUR' END,
         projete_le = now()
   WHERE cand.id = (SELECT id FROM cible) AND cand.statut NOT IN ('ENVOYEE', 'REFUSEE')
  RETURNING cand.id
),
dec AS (
  INSERT INTO career_ops.decision AS d2 (candidature_id, type, consigne, raison, decidee_le, revision)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM cible),
         CASE WHEN d->>'decision' IN ('valider', 'retoucher_lettre', 'retoucher_cv', 'refuser')
              THEN d->>'decision' ELSE 'decision_invalide' END,
         NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'consigne', '')), ''),
         NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'raison', '')), ''),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'decide_le', '')::timestamptz, now()),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'revision', '')::int, 0)
  FROM e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cible)
  ON CONFLICT (candidature_id, revision) DO UPDATE SET
    type = EXCLUDED.type, consigne = EXCLUDED.consigne, raison = EXCLUDED.raison,
    decidee_le = EXCLUDED.decidee_le, projete_le = now()
  RETURNING d2.id, d2.type, d2.revision
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM cible) AS candidature_id, (SELECT id FROM dec) AS decision_id,
       (SELECT type FROM dec) AS decision_type, (SELECT revision FROM dec) AS revision,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM maj) AS statut_maj

WITH e AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d),
maj AS (
  UPDATE career_ops.candidature cand
     SET statut = 'ENVOYEE',
         envoyee_le = COALESCE(cand.envoyee_le, NULLIF(d->>'envoyee_le', '')::timestamptz, now()),
         message_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'message_id', '')), ''), cand.message_id),
         tag_archive = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'tag_archive', '')), ''), cand.tag_archive),
         projete_le = now()
    FROM e
   WHERE cand.branche_github = d->>'branche_github'
  RETURNING cand.id, cand.envoyee_le
),
rel AS (
  INSERT INTO career_ops.relance (candidature_id, echeance, rang)
  SELECT id, (envoyee_le + make_interval(days => career_ops.parametre_entier('relance_delai_jours', 7)))::date, 1
  FROM maj
  ON CONFLICT (candidature_id, echeance) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, echeance
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM maj) AS candidature_id, (SELECT envoyee_le FROM maj) AS envoyee_le,
       (SELECT echeance FROM rel) AS relance_echeance, (SELECT count(*) FROM maj) AS candidature_maj

SELECT 'offre' AS objet, count(*) AS lignes, 3 AS attendu, 6 AS insertions_tentees
FROM career_ops.offre WHERE id LIKE 'zz-test-%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'candidature', count(*), 3, 6 FROM career_ops.candidature c
  JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id WHERE o.id LIKE 'zz-test-%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'decision', count(*), 3, 6 FROM career_ops.decision d
  JOIN career_ops.candidature c ON c.id = d.candidature_id
  JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id WHERE o.id LIKE 'zz-test-%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'relance', count(*), 2, 4 FROM career_ops.relance r
  JOIN career_ops.candidature c ON c.id = r.candidature_id
  JOIN career_ops.offre o ON o.id = c.offre_id WHERE o.id LIKE 'zz-test-%'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.offre_id, v.entreprise, v.poste, v.lieu, v.teletravail, v.score,
       v.statut, v.label_career_ops, v.derniere_decision, v.derniere_raison,
       v.envoyee_le, v.tag_archive, c.message_id, v.revision
FROM career_ops.v_candidature v
JOIN career_ops.candidature c ON c.id = v.id
WHERE v.offre_id LIKE 'zz-test-%'
ORDER BY v.offre_id

SELECT entreprise, poste, courriel_contact, envoyee_le, jours_depuis_envoi,
       echeance, jours_de_retard, rang, echeance_recalculee, tag_archive
FROM career_ops.v_relance_due
ORDER BY jours_de_retard DESC, entreprise

  SELECT

    NULLIF(d->>'score', '')::smallint,
    NULLIF(d->>'publiee_le', '')::date,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d->>'pourquoi_ca_matche', '')), ''),
    d->>'fiche_path',
    d->>'schema'
  FROM f
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    source = EXCLUDED.source, poste = EXCLUDED.poste, entreprise = EXCLUDED.entreprise,
    lieu = EXCLUDED.lieu, teletravail = EXCLUDED.teletravail, url = EXCLUDED.url,
    courriel_contact = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.courriel_contact, cible.courriel_contact),
    score = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.score, cible.score),
    publiee_le = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.publiee_le, cible.publiee_le),
    pourquoi_ca_matche = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pourquoi_ca_matche, cible.pourquoi_ca_matche),
    fiche_path = EXCLUDED.fiche_path, fiche_schema = EXCLUDED.fiche_schema, projete_le = now()
  RETURNING cible.id
)

nodes.name: 11 · reprojection depuis les fiches (db/reproject.mjs)
nodes.notes: SQL genere par `node db/reproject.mjs`. Prouve qu'une fiche data-inbox/*.json suffit a reconstruire offre + candidature + decisions + relance, sans n8n.

parameters.query:
SELECT v.offre_id, v.entreprise, v.lieu, v.score, v.statut, v.label_career_ops,
       c.message_id, v.tag_archive, v.revision,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM career_ops.decision d WHERE d.candidature_id = v.id) AS decisions,
       (SELECT string_agg(d.type || ' (rev ' || d.revision || ')', ' puis ' ORDER BY d.revision)
          FROM career_ops.decision d WHERE d.candidature_id = v.id) AS enchainement,
       (SELECT d.consigne FROM career_ops.decision d
         WHERE d.candidature_id = v.id AND d.consigne IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS consigne_retouche,
       (SELECT r.echeance FROM career_ops.relance r WHERE r.candidature_id = v.id LIMIT 1) AS relance_echeance,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM career_ops.v_relance_due rd WHERE rd.candidature_id = v.id) AS relance_due
FROM career_ops.v_candidature v
JOIN career_ops.candidature c ON c.id = v.id
WHERE v.offre_id LIKE 'zz-rp-%'
